name: chat-thread
description: A conversation log on a themed wallpaper: a role='log' scroll container that opens on the newest message and stays pinned to it as messages arrive — in CSS alone, with column-reverse — holding chat-message entries, sticky date pills, centred system lines and an unread divider. The wallpaper's doodle is drawn from the ink and the accent, so it is faint and on-hue in every theme and both schemes.

messages.description: The ONE child of the root: an ordered list of entries (chat-message items, day, system and unread lines). Keep it the only child — the stick-to-bottom behaviour depends on it.

day.description: Date separator pill ('Today', 'Yesterday', 'Tue 21 Oct'), sticky to the top while its day is on screen. Wrap the words in a <time datetime>.

system.description: A centred, muted line that is not a message: someone joined, the group was renamed, the encryption note. May start with an aria-hidden icon primitive.

unread.description: Divider above the first unread message ('3 unread messages').

wallpaper.description: doodle = the patterned wallpaper; plain = the wallpaper colour alone.

size.description: Message text scale: sm = text-xs, md = text-sm, lg = text-base. Inherited by every chat-message through --chat-text-size.

--chat-thread-height.description: Block size of the log (custom property). Give the thread a height — or put it in a flex/grid cell that does — so it scrolls instead of growing.

--chat-wallpaper.description: Wallpaper colour under the doodle (custom property). Keep it the opposite side of the incoming bubble fill so bubbles stand off it.

--chat-doodle-ink.description: Ink of the neutral doodle marks (custom property).

--chat-doodle-accent.description: Ink of the accent doodle marks (custom property).

keyboard.Tab: focus the log (it is a scroll container), then the controls inside its messages
keyboard.ArrowUp / ArrowDown: scroll the focused log line by line
keyboard.PageUp / PageDown: scroll the focused log a screen at a time
keyboard.Home / End: jump to the oldest / newest loaded message

notes: role='log' is an implicit polite live region with aria-relevant='additions text': a message appended to [data-part='messages'] — or a typing indicator revealed — is announced without moving focus.
Name the log for its conversation ('Conversation with Maya Chen', 'Lisbon trip, group chat').
Date pills, system lines and the unread divider are plain list items, read in order with the messages.
The column-reverse layout changes visual scroll origin only; DOM order, reading order and focus order stay oldest-first.

templates.html:
1. {day_label}
  2. {sender}

    {text}

    {time}
  3. You

    {reply}

    {reply_time}
